T=G['Test input']; out=f(T)
import json
for r in out: print(r)
open('programs/task-28ba0067.py','w').write('''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bgc=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            nbs=[g[i+di][j+dj] for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=i+di<h and 0<=j+dj<w]
            if nbs and g[i][j] not in nbs:
                c=Counter(nbs); m=max(c.values()); cands=[k for k,x in c.items() if x==m]
                g[i][j]= cands[0] if len(cands)==1 else (cands[1] if cands[0]==bgc and len(cands)==2 else next(k for k in cands if k!=bgc))
    return g
''')
json.dump([{"input":I,"output":O}], open('programs/task-28ba0067.json','w'))
print(json.dumps(out))
